title: WSU comes up short in Apple Cup loss, 24-10

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: WSU comes up short in Apple Cup loss, 24-10
sources.description: The 2026 opener didn’t end how Washington State wanted. However, the game itself gave signs of encouragement for the rest of the season. The Cougars opened with the 118th edition of the Apple Cup at Husky Stadium and lost to archrival Washington, 24-10. Despite some early offensive woes, WSU (0-1) found themselves in a one-possession […]
